title: UsefulDecor: Interactive Craft
description: A decorative mod focused on adding fully interactive furniture, functional blocks, and advanced gameplay mechanics.
body:
# UsefulDecor: Interactive Craft

**UsefulDecor: Interactive Craft** is a unique Minecraft mod designed to transform your survival world by adding fully functional, interactable furniture and decorative blocks. Instead of traditional cosmetic decorations, this mod focuses on items that bring real utility and practical value to your home.

### Key Features:
* **Interactive Clocks** — Decorative wall clocks (available in round and square designs) that dynamically track and display actual in-game time.
* **Reinforced Windows** — Stylish oak windows with a diamond lattice pattern, perfect for upgrading your house security and aesthetic design.
### Why choose UsefulDecor?
If you are looking for a immersive decoration mod that perfectly balances aesthetics and utility, **UsefulDecor** is the ideal choice. Upgrade your base building experience, enhance your interior design, and enjoy interactable blocks that are actually useful in your everyday adventures!
